title: Galinhada (Brazilian chicken and rice with turmeric)
steps: Cut the chicken into pieces, season with lime juice, garlic and salt and brown all over in the oil in a wide pot.
Dice the onion, tomato and pepper, add them and fry for 4 minutes, then stir in the turmeric.
Add the rice and stock, bring to the boil and cook covered over low heat for about 35 minutes.
Add the peas for the last 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with parsley and spring onion.
